Name: EQUIP_PARAM_ACCESSORY_ST
Description: Accessories (talismans). Each holds up to three effects as AttachEffectParam IDs; accessories that share an Accessory Group can't be worn together.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Development flag for network-test builds.

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Weight, added to the equip load with the other worn equipment.

Fields.Name: Sale Value
Fields.Description: Shop price used when the shop lineup's own value is below 0: this value × the lineup's multiplier + its addition (same as weapons, armour and goods). Retail 0 on every talisman, −1 on one row.

Fields.Name: Sell Value
Fields.Description: Sell price of the talisman. Retail: 100, 500 or 1000 on most rows.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Sort order of the talisman in the inventory when sorting by order.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon ID.
Appears unused by the game. Retail −1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Accessory Group
Fields.Description: Two talismans with the same group (not −1) cannot be worn together. Retail: each talisman has its own group.

Fields.Name: Accessory Category
Fields.Description: Item category: 0 is a talisman (gives the talisman item type in item handling); other values give the generic type. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Rarity
Fields.Description: Rarity, shown in menus and in the pop-up when the talisman is picked up.

Fields.Name: Sort Group ID
Fields.Description: Sort group: talismans with the same group are listed together when sorting by item type. 255: none.
Appears unused by the game. Retail −1, and 17 on the three Old Lord's Talisman rows.

Fields.Name: Can Be Stored
Fields.Description: Set: the item can be stored (same flag as on weapons, armour and goods). Retail set on all used talismans.
Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Can Drop
Fields.Description: The talisman can be dropped on the ground. Retail: set on every talisman.
Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.
Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.
Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Removed by Inventory Cleanup
Fields.Description: Set: the item is removed from the inventory by an inventory cleanup pass (the same check reads weapons' Disable Get and matching bits on armour and goods); when the pass runs is not established. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: List in Visual Codex
Fields.Description: The talisman is listed in the Visual Codex. Retail: set on 61 rows.
Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Attach Effect 1
Fields.Description: Attach effect (AttachEffectParam) applied while the talisman is worn; its SpEffects are added to the wearer's. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Attach Effect 2
Fields.Description: Second attach effect (AttachEffectParam) applied while the talisman is worn. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Attach Effect 3
Fields.Description: Third attach effect (AttachEffectParam) applied while the talisman is worn. −1: none.
